resources.string: Black frame insertion (beta, may reduce performance)
A black frame between normal ones for sharper motion
On. The screen is darker and may flicker.

Shows a black frame between normal frames, like an old CRT screen. Moving pictures look sharper, but the screen gets darker and can flicker. Needs a refresh rate of 100 Hz or more. Turns off when the rate goes below that, and on restart. While the screen is off it pauses.
1 normal, 1 black is the one that has been tried. More black frames make it darker and flicker more.

Black frame insertion flashes the whole screen many times a second. Don\'t use it if flashing lights can give you seizures or headaches. Stop at once if you feel unwell.\n\nIt also makes the screen darker, and on some panels it flickers or leaves an image behind. It may make games run slower.
Needs 100 Hz or more. Set Display > Peak refresh rate higher first.
Black frame insertion turned off: the screen is below 100 Hz now.
